education.description: SUN2020 education level codes to schema labels

employment.description: AKU (Labour Force Survey) status codes to schema labels

urbanization.description: Swedish urbanization classification to schema labels

socioeconomic.description: Income bracket groups to socioeconomic class labels (SamForvInk1, relative to country median)

poverty.description: Individual gross income < 60% of national median (Eurostat AROP threshold)

working_class.description: Individual gross income 60–100% of national median (OECD lower-middle floor)

middle_class.description: Individual gross income 100–200% of national median (OECD middle band)

wealthy.description: Individual gross income >= 200% of national median (OECD/Pew upper income)

birth_location.description: Country of birth / world region to schema labels

scb_codes: married or cohabiting mother and stepparent
married or cohabiting father and stepparent
living with persons other than parents

region.description: Swedish counties (Län) — population distribution from BE/BE0101/BE0101A/BefolkningNy; env_type derived from locality urbanization share (MI/MI0810/MI0810A/BefLandInvKvmTO, 2023)

civil_status.description: Marital status from BE/BE0101/BE0101A/BefolkningNy — Civilstand variable. Conditional on age_group × biological_sex.

industry_sector.description: Industry sector from AM/AM0401/AM0401I/AKURLSysSNI07Ar — SNI2007 (NACE Rev. 2) classification. Marginal among employed persons (no age cross-tab available). Non-employed get 'Not Applicable'.

employment_type.description: Employment contract type, combining attachment (permanent/temporary/self-employed) from AM/AM0401/AM0401I/AKURLSysAnkAr and working-hours (full-time/part-time) from AM/AM0401/AM0401S/NAKUSysselOkArbtidAr. Both conditional on age_group. Non-employed get 'Not Applicable'.

age_groups.description: Age group labels used in the output — standardized bins

housing_tenure.description: Dwelling ownership form from BO/BO0104/BO0104D/BO0104T04. Marginal distribution combining Hustyp (building type) and Upplatelseform (tenure form). Cross-tab by socioeconomic class and age is not available at national level in this table.

household_size.description: Number of persons in household from BE/BE0101/BE0101S/HushallT03. Marginal distribution. No cross-tab with parental_structure is available at national level in this table.

income_source.description: Primary income source from HE/HE0110/HE0110F/TabVX13InkStruktN — percentage share of each income component, conditional on employment status and broad age group. Values are used as sampling weights.

scb_income_codes.320: sickness compensation, parental allowance, labour market assistance etc.

ethnicity.description: Broad ethnicity categories for comparison with SCB birth-location proxy

birth_country_detail.description: Country of birth (detailed) from BE/BE0101/BE0101E/FodelselandArK. Conditional on birth_location: if Sweden → always 'Sweden'; if foreign-born → sample from distribution of top origin countries (adults 18-85, 2024). Remaining countries collapse to 'Other'.
